[[File:Rdr2_dreamcatcher.jpg|thumb|350px]]
'''Dreamcatchers''' are one of the types of collectibles in ''[[Red Dead Redemption 2]]''. If the player manages to find all dreamcatchers, they will earn the [[Ancient Arrowhead]]. This side-quest is needed for the [[100% Completion (RDR2)|100% Completion]] of the game. There are a total of 20 Dreamcatchers.

==Description==
You've discovered Dreamcatchers in the wild. Find all Dreamcatchers to reveal their secret.<ref>In-game Description.</ref>

Once all Dreamcatchers have been found, a journal entry connects all the points of the found Dreamcatchers. The eye of the drawn animal is located at [[Elysian Pool]], behind the waterfall, in the wide branched off cave. The player must keep to the left, following the trail of water, and on the right of the large cave, a path branches off, where the player will find the treasure. There are a few cave paintings that can be inspected. In the eye of a bison, lies the ancient arrowhead.

==Oversights==
* Even when the player has found all Dreamcatcher locations, the mission task may still appear in the player's log.
